venue_name.description: Venue name exactly as shown on the page

address.description: Full street address in Latin script. Country must be written 'Indonesia', never in Cyrillic. Empty string if absent.

district.description: Area/district as stated on the page. If it contradicts the address, still report what the page says; the mismatch is resolved downstream.

official_website_url.description: ONLY the venue's own website. If the link points to instagram.com, taplink.cc, linktr.ee, gofood, grab, a link aggregator or a booking marketplace, return an empty string and put that link in other_links instead.

other_links.description: Any link that was offered as 'website' but is not a real venue site

benefit_verbatim.description: The discount/perk wording exactly as printed on the page

discount_percent.description: Numeric percent if the benefit is a percentage discount; omit if not

complimentary_item.description: Free item, if the benefit is a gift rather than a percentage

valid_until.description: Expiry date if stated, ISO format. Empty if the page states none.

phone.description: Collect but it will be discarded downstream; do not guess
